summary: Teleflex Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the refinancing of its existing credit agreement via a new Credit Agreement with a syndicate of lenders. The facility comprises a $1B five-year revolver, a $500M term A-1 loan due 2031, and a $700M term A-2 loan due 2028. Borrowings bear interest at Term SOFR plus 1.125%-2.00% or an alternate base rate plus 0.125%-1.00%. Obligations are guaranteed by material domestic subsidiaries and secured by liens on substantially all assets and equity pledges. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation.
